text: Use SF Pro Display, Geist Sans, Helvetica Neue, or Switzer as the primary sans-serif font
Use Lyon Text, Newsreader, Playfair Display, or Instrument Serif as the editorial serif font for hero headings
Apply tight tracking of letter-spacing: -0.02em to -0.04em to editorial serif text
Use off-black/charcoal #111111 or #2F3437 for body text with line-height 1.6
Use muted gray #787774 for secondary text
Use pure white #FFFFFF or warm bone/off-white #F7F6F3/#FBFBFA for canvas/background
Use #F9F9F8 or #FFFFFF for primary surface (cards)
Use ultra-light gray #EAEAEA or rgba(0,0,0,0.06) for structural borders and dividers
Use pale red #FDEBEC with text #9F2F2D as accent color for tags or inline code
Use pale blue #E1F3FE with text #1F6C9F as accent color for tags or inline code
Use pale green #EDF3EC with text #346538 as accent color for tags or inline code
Use pale yellow #FBF3DB with text #956400 as accent color for tags or inline code
Cards must have exactly border: 1px solid #EAEAEA
Set card border-radius to 8px or 12px maximum
Set card internal padding to 24px to 40px
Primary CTA buttons: solid background #111111, text #FFFFFF
Primary CTA buttons: border-radius 4px to 6px, no box-shadow
Primary CTA buttons: hover state color shift to #333333 or transform: scale(0.98)
Tags and status badges: pill-shaped (border-radius: 9999px), text-xs uppercase with letter-spacing 0.05em
Tags and badges: background must use defined muted pastels
Accordions: strip all container boxes, separate items only with border-bottom: 1px solid #EAEAEA
Accordions: use clean sharp + and - icons for toggle state
Render shortcuts as physical keys using <kbd> tags with border: 1px solid #EAEAEA, border-radius: 4px, background: #F7F6F3, monospace font
Wrap software mockups in minimalist container with white top bar and three small light gray circles replicating macOS window controls
Use Phosphor Icons (Bold or Fill weights) or Radix UI Icons for icons
Standardize stroke width across all icons
Create illustrations as monochromatic rough continuous-line ink sketches on white background with single geometric shape filled with muted pastel
Use high-quality desaturated images with warm tone for photography
Apply subtle warm grain overlay with opacity: 0.04 to blend photography into monochrome palette
Use placeholders https://picsum.photos/seed/{context}/1200/800 when real assets are unavailable
Use subtle full-width background imagery at very low opacity for hero/section backgrounds
Use soft radial light spots radial-gradient with warm tones at opacity: 0.03
Fade in elements as they enter viewport using translateY(12px) + opacity: 0 over 600ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)
Use IntersectionObserver for scroll entry animations, never window.addEventListener('scroll')
Cards lift with box-shadow transitioning from 0 0 0 to 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.04) over 200ms on hover
Buttons respond with scale(0.98) on :active
Lists and grid items enter with cascade delay animation-delay: calc(var(--index) * 80ms), never mount everything at once
Use single slow-moving radial gradient blob animation-duration: 20s+, opacity: 0.02-0.04 behind hero sections
Apply background ambient motion to position: fixed; pointer-events: none layer, never on scrolling containers
Animate exclusively via transform and opacity, no layout-triggering properties (top, left, width, height)
Use will-change: transform sparingly and only on actively animating elements
Establish macro-whitespace first with massive vertical padding between sections (py-24 or py-32 in Tailwind)
Constrain main typography content width to max-w-4xl or max-w-5xl
Ensure every card, divider, and border adheres strictly to 1px solid #EAEAEA rule
Add scroll-entry animations to all major content blocks
Ensure sections have visual depth through imagery, ambient gradients, or subtle textures, no empty flat backgrounds
This protocol enforces a high-contrast warm monochrome palette and actively rejects standard generic SaaS design trends
The goal of motion guidelines is quiet sophistication, not spectacle
Color is a scarce resource utilized only for semantic meaning or subtle accents
The interface relies on extreme typographic contrast and premium font selection to establish an editorial feel
